Compare Milan bachata festival dates and venues: Milano Sensual Congress in November 2026, Europe Bachata Festival and Bachata Day. Plan your dance weekend.

Looking for a **bachata festival in Milan in 2026 or 2027**? Milano Sensual Congress, Europe Bachata Festival and Bachata Day take place on different weekends and at different venues around Milan. The practical question is which dates, workshop format and travel plan fit you.

### Why choose Milano Sensual Congress?

Choose Milano Sensual when you want to spend your weekend learning Bachata Sensual and putting it straight into practice on the social floor. Workshops, shows and parties share the [four-star Devero Hotel venue](https://milanosensualcongress.com/hotel), with a programme that gives you time to dance in the afternoon as well as at night.

#### Workshops for your level, taught in English

Every scheduled workshop hour has three rooms: **beginner / open, intermediate and advanced**. You can choose a session that fits your experience instead of feeling you have to attempt every class. Read the [workshop levels guide](https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/bachata-workshop-levels-guide-congress) and check the [programme](https://milanosensualcongress.com/program) before planning your day.

The [2026 artist line-up](https://milanosensualcongress.com/artists) includes Gero y Migle, Klau y Ros, Cristian y Gabriella, David y Ines, Nacho y Silvia and more. All workshops are taught in English, making the classes accessible to visitors travelling to Italy.

#### Afternoon socials and nights until 05:00

The [party schedule](https://milanosensualcongress.com/parties) includes Friday and Saturday nights from 23:00 to 05:00, a Saturday afternoon social from 16:00 to 20:00, and Sunday dancing from 16:00 to 22:00. Build in breaks, then return to the floor with the ideas you explored in class.

#### A clear plan for your pass and stay

The [Full Pass](https://milanosensualcongress.com/tickets) includes regular workshops and parties. Masterclasses are separate: the [Masterclass Upgrade](https://milanosensualcongress.com/masterclass) costs **€59** and requires a Full Pass. Jack & Jill participation also has a separate fee. Hotel rooms are booked separately; choose Devero for an on-site stay or check the AS Hotel Cambiago option, 800 metres away, on the hotel page.

[See passes for Milano Sensual](https://milanosensualcongress.com/tickets)

### The other dates in the Milan calendar

#### Europe Bachata Festival · October 2026

Europe Bachata Festival runs from **22 to 25 October 2026** at Grand Hotel Barone di Sassj in Sesto San Giovanni. Its programme includes workshops, shows and night parties. This is a separate October event; Milano Sensual Congress takes place the following month at Devero.

#### Bachata Day · March 2027

Bachata Day takes place from **5 to 7 March 2027** at Crowne Plaza Milano Linate in San Donato Milanese, with workshops, shows and parties. Its March dates belong to a different part of the season from Milano Sensual Congress in November.

### How to choose your Milan bachata weekend

- **Start with your available dates.**
  For Milano Sensual, plan around 20–22 November and check the Sunday social before deciding when to travel home.
- **Choose classes you can enjoy.**
  Match your experience to the workshop level and leave room for social dancing. If this is your first congress, our
  [first congress guide](https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/what-to-expect-bachata-congress-2026)
  explains the format.
- **Budget for the whole trip.**
  Check your pass, room, travel and any optional extras together. A festival name containing “Milan” does not mean its venue is in the city centre.
- **Arrange the final leg of your journey.**
  Milano Sensual offers
  [transfers by advance booking](https://milanosensualcongress.com/transfer)
  from Malpensa, Linate, Bergamo and Milano Centrale. Use the actual service details to plan your arrival.

### Questions about bachata festivals in Milan

#### Are Milano Sensual Congress, Europe Bachata Festival and Bachata Day the same event?

No. They are separate events with different dates and venues. Milano Sensual Congress takes place on 20–22 November 2026 at Devero Hotel in Cavenago di Brianza.

#### Can beginners attend Milano Sensual Congress?

Yes. Every scheduled workshop hour offers a beginner / open room alongside intermediate and advanced rooms. Choose the sessions that match your experience; all workshops are taught in English.

### Make November your Milano Sensual weekend

Three days of Bachata Sensual, workshops for your level and afternoon and night socials at Devero Hotel. Join us on 20–22 November 2026.
